name: Paperclip
note: Agent org control plane. Verified working on the overnight bench — boots clean, embedded Postgres, telemetry off.

name: agent-browser
note: Browser automation CLI for agents — accessibility-tree snapshots at a fraction of screenshot token cost. Daily driver.

name: Firecrawl
note: Scrape/crawl/extract API for pages that fight plain fetch. Its X postprocessor is the only reliable way I read tweets programmatically.

name: Hermes
note: Telegram-gateway agent runtime I run 24/7 (v0.20.5 + lifecycle manager). Inbound queue has a known interruption quirk.

name: improve (shadcn skill)
note: Plan-cheap-execute optimization loop as a Claude skill. Cherry-picked from the bench.

name: davidondrej skill pack
note: Three skills kept after a security read: risky-changes (adapted), folder-specific-claude-md, effective-agent-skills.

name: Synara
note: Desktop app builds and boots clean end-to-end (Bun + Electron). Works; not yet part of the daily stack.

name: Eve
note: Vercel's agent sandbox. Scaffolded and ready to test — needs Node 24.

name: Headlong
note: Persistent agent harness. Installed on a Factory droid backend; first real run still pending.

name: Buzz
note: Block's agent workspace. Cloned, never judged — the source build wants multi-GB toolchain and disk ran out mid-bench. Prebuilt release is the easy path.

name: Cabinet
note: Won my head-to-head demo comparison against two alternatives; full re-scaffold pending. Promising.

name: cloudflare-os
note: Lost the same head-to-head to Cabinet on my use case.

name: Dinky
note: Unsigned app from a personal tap — not worth the trust exception.

name: pxpipe
note: Token-saving MITM proxy with documented silent string corruption. Unusable anywhere fidelity matters.

name: WUPHF
note: Weaker take on what Buzz does, with a restrictive license on top.

name: hubble.md
note: Duplicates my existing markdown vault workflow.

name: Macro
note: The workspace product turned out to be a Notion replacement, not the PDF tool I wanted.

name: Papercuts
note: Fine tool, but requires a Rust toolchain I don't want to carry right now.

name: lazyweb skill
note: Design-research skill pack with a curl|bash installer; paid tier can decrypt browser cookies. Only ever deliberately.

name: Is Agentic
note: Score how ready a website is for AI agents, then get evidence and recommendations to improve it.
